source.name: Toro.it, 'Serie A, ecco quanto guadagna il Torino dallo sponsor di maglia'
source.quote: Il Torino guadagna, invece, 2,35 milioni da Suzuki.
source.note: Translation: 'Torino, instead, earns 2.35 million from Suzuki.' Press estimate from a March 2026 survey of Serie A shirt-sponsor revenues, before the 2026/27 renewal; the club and Suzuki do not publish a figure. The club's renewal announcement (3 July 2026) says the partnership began in 2013 and reached its fourteenth consecutive season in 2026/27.
